page.layout: One column of index entries on one printed page. Heading "INDEX." at the top, centred. Then alphabetical letter headings I and L, each followed by entries with page numbers set at the right. Signature "Ll 2" at the foot. No running head, no page number, no margin notes.

main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: Leonum similes nunc laudantur, nunc vituperantur | 200

page.notes: The printed line "Leonis Byzantii uxor obesior illo ]" carries a closing bracket after the number's line; it is not transcribed as text. The stray marks on the left edge of the scan are damage and are left out. "Ll 2" at the foot is the gathering signature. Page numbers are given in the printed form, with dots where the printer set them. The first letter of "Iacobus" is a large decorative initial, transcribed as I.
